reason: Reads the element handle a console message's argument refers to, and clicks it; Strider's ConsoleMessage has no arguments

Waits for a dialog on the context, as well as on the page; Dialog.next and Dialog.stream take a page only, so a dialog can't be watched from its context. The matrix row says the context event is had, which the Dialog API doesn't show
Waits for a dialog's close, however it was decided; Strider reports a dialog as it opens, not as it closes
Reads the script location an uncaught error was thrown from (url, line, column); Strider's UncaughtException has no location
Waits for a page's load on the context; Strider has no context-level load event
Waits for a frame's navigation on the context; Strider has no context-level frame navigation event
Waits for a page's close on the context; Strider reports a page's close on the page (closed), not on the context
Waits for a frame's attachment on the context; Strider has no context-level frame attached event
Waits for a frame's detachment on the context; Strider has no context-level frame detached event
Reads the page a download came from; Strider's Download doesn't name its originating page
